rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The filterByTimePeriod function was filtering leads by their created_at date before passing to stats calculation. When 'Today' was selected, 0 leads were returned because no leads were created today - they were created on previous dates. The stats calculation then received 0 leads and returned 0 for all stats.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Separated the filtering logic: 1) baseFilteredLeads applies all filters EXCEPT time filter, 2) Stats are calculated from baseFilteredLeads using activity timestamps (login_done_at, approved_at, disbursed_at), 3) Leads list uses time-filtered leads for display
